name: Nijiiro Canvas
source:
The lead character is a boy dreaming of becoming a teacher has been giving private lessons to the pretty twin sisters: Yuzuki and Mizuki. In the summer vacation, he happens to live with them for 10 days after a strange turn of events.

[from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE027824.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
梦想成为教师的男主角，正在为美丽的双胞胎姐妹柚月和美月补习。暑假里，一次意外让他和她们同住十天。

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE027824.html]DLsite English[/url]]
